XMLDB.COMMENT: XMLDB file for the Rumbos course format

TABLE.NAME: format_rumbos_flow
TABLE.COMMENT: Which step of a Rumbos welcome flow each user completed, and how

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course the flow belongs to

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The user who completed the step

FIELD.NAME: mapid
FIELD.COMMENT: The Rumbos map UUID, opaque to Moodle

FIELD.NAME: stepkey
FIELD.COMMENT: The step of the flow

FIELD.NAME: revision
FIELD.COMMENT: The revision of the step that was completed

FIELD.NAME: method
FIELD.COMMENT: completed, fallback or unavailable

FIELD.NAME: timecompleted
FIELD.COMMENT: When the step was completed

TABLE.NAME: format_rumbos_result
TABLE.COMMENT: Assessment results applied from verified statements of the Rumbos service: one row per attempt

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course the result belongs to

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The student the result belongs to

FIELD.NAME: purpose
FIELD.COMMENT: check_in or final

FIELD.NAME: attemptid
FIELD.COMMENT: The attempt in the Rumbos service: the idempotency key

FIELD.NAME: jti
FIELD.COMMENT: The statement id: the replay guard

FIELD.NAME: payloadhash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the statement's normalised claims

FIELD.NAME: percent
FIELD.COMMENT: Decimal string with two decimals, as sent

FIELD.NAME: passed
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the Rumbos service decided it is a pass

FIELD.NAME: timefinished
FIELD.COMMENT: When the attempt finished

FIELD.NAME: timeapplied
FIELD.COMMENT: When Moodle applied it

TABLE.NAME: format_rumbos_audit
TABLE.COMMENT: Every result statement received, accepted or rejected, with the reason

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: When the statement arrived

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: The HTTP status answered

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: Why: completed, recorded, already_applied or a rejection reason

FIELD.NAME: kid
FIELD.COMMENT: The key id of the statement header

FIELD.NAME: jti
FIELD.COMMENT: The statement id, only once its signature was verified

FIELD.NAME: attemptid
FIELD.COMMENT: The attempt, only once the signature was verified

FIELD.NAME: subject
FIELD.COMMENT: The pseudonymous user reference of the statement

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: The course, 0 when unknown

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The Moodle user once resolved, 0 otherwise

FIELD.NAME: purpose
FIELD.COMMENT: check_in or final

FIELD.NAME: percent
FIELD.COMMENT: The percent as sent

FIELD.NAME: passed
FIELD.COMMENT: The passed flag as sent

FIELD.NAME: policy
FIELD.COMMENT: The policy as sent, for example gt:80
